extensionName.message: フォルダーフィルタースケジューラー

extensionDescription.message: 受信トレイだけでなく、任意のフォルダーでフィルタールールをスケジュール実行。差出人、件名、アドレス帳、SPF・DKIM・DMARC で判定します。
extensionDescription.description: Short description shown in the add-ons manager.

common_addSpamDomains.message: 迷惑メールのドメインを追加
common_addSpamDomains.description: Right-click menu item and title of the window that adds the sender domains of the selected messages to a spam rule.

common_runAllRulesNow.message: すべてのルールを今すぐ実行
common_runAllRulesNow.description: Button on the settings page and in the toolbar popup, and a right-click menu item. Runs every rule once, right away.

common_restoreDefaults.description: Button that puts the settings of a section back to their default values.

common_allowTagAccess.message: タグへのアクセスを許可...
common_allowTagAccess.description: Button that asks Thunderbird for permission to list the user's message tags.

common_noTag.description: Shown in place of a tag name when no tag is chosen.

common_untitledRule.description: Name used for a rule whose name is empty.

common_quoted.description: A rule name in quotation marks, inside a longer message. Use the quotation marks of your language. $1 is the name.

menu_runARule.description: Right-click submenu that lists the rules; choosing one runs it.

options_theme.description: Label for the light, dark, and system theme switch. Read by screen readers only.

options_themeSystem.description: Theme switch: follow the Thunderbird theme. Read by screen readers only.

options_themeSystemTitle.message: システム: Thunderbird に合わせる
options_themeSystemTitle.description: Tooltip of the theme switch button that follows the Thunderbird theme.

options_tagline.message: 任意のフォルダーでルールをタイマー実行します。標準の Thunderbird では受信トレイでしか自動実行されない部分を補います。
options_tagline.description: One-line explanation under the page title.

options_runEvery.description: Label around the number box for the default timer. $1 is the number box; keep it.

options_save.description: Button that saves every rule and setting on the page.

options_collapseAll.description: Button that folds every rule card to a one-line summary.

options_expandAll.description: Button that opens every folded rule card.

options_export.description: Button that saves the rules to a JSON file.

options_import.description: Button that loads rules from a JSON file.

options_addRule.description: Button that adds an empty rule card.

allowlist_title.message: 保護するドメイン (ブロックしない)
allowlist_title.description: Heading of the section with the domains that Add spam domains never adds.

allowlist_hint.message: メッセージ一覧から迷惑メールのドメインを追加するとき、ここにあるドメインは除外されます。誤って選択しても大手プロバイダーをブロックしないためのものです。1 行に 1 ドメインを入力します。
allowlist_hint.description: Explanation of the protected domains list.

diag_title.description: Heading of the section with the diagnostics report.

diag_hint.message: 期待どおりに動作しない場合は、このレポートをメッセージに添えて送ってください。レポートには Thunderbird のバージョン、各ルールの構成、最近の実行内容が含まれます。下のチェックボックスをオンにしない限り、アドレス、ドメイン、パターン、フォルダー名は含まれません。ここに表示されている内容がそのまま共有されます。
diag_hint.description: Explanation of the diagnostics report. The report itself stays in English.

diag_includeValues.message: ルールの値 (アドレス、ドメイン、パターン、フォルダー) を含める
diag_includeValues.description: Checkbox that adds the values of each rule to the diagnostics report.

diag_copy.description: Button that copies the diagnostics report to the clipboard.

diag_save.description: Button that saves the diagnostics report to a text file.

diag_refresh.description: Button that rebuilds the diagnostics report.

diag_clear.description: Button that deletes the diagnostics log.

diag_buildFailed.message: レポートを作成できませんでした: $1
diag_buildFailed.description: Shown in the report box when the report fails. $1 is the error message, in English.

adv_title.description: Heading of the Advanced settings section. Other messages refer to it in …; use the same word there.

adv_hint.message: スキャン処理のタイミングです。ほとんどの場合は初期設定のままで問題ありません。理由がある場合だけ変更してください。保存時に、各値は安全な範囲に収められます。
adv_hint.description: Explanation at the top of the Advanced section.

adv_logScheduleRuns.message: ルール独自のスケジュールによる実行をすべて記録する

adv_logScheduleRunsHint.message: オフにすると、診断ログにはメールを変更した実行と失敗した実行だけが記録されます。1 分ごとに実行するルールがあると、古い記録が数時間でログから押し出されてしまうためです。変更を反映するには 保存 を選択します。
adv_logScheduleRunsHint.description: Explanation of the checkbox that logs every scheduled run. Keep … around the name of the Save button.

adv_runOnNewMail.message: 新着メールの受信時にも実行する

adv_runOnNewMailHint.message: オフにすると、ルールは上のタイマーでのみ実行されるため、新着メールは最長でその間隔だけ待つことになります。Thunderbird はメールが届くたびにそれを通知します。
adv_runOnNewMailHint.description: Explanation of the checkbox that runs rules on new mail.

adv_newMailDelay.message: 最後の受信から $1 秒待ってから実行
adv_newMailDelay.description: Label around a number box. $1 is the number box; keep it.

adv_newMailDelayHint.message: 1 回のメール同期で多数のメッセージが通知されます。待つことで、それらをまとめて 1 回の実行で処理します。Thunderbird はアイドル状態のアドオンを停止するため、上限は 15 秒です。
adv_newMailDelayHint.description: Explanation of the delay before a run on new mail.

adv_catchUp.message: $1 分ごとに、過去 $2 日分を対象に補完スキャンを実行
adv_catchUp.description: Label around two number boxes. $1 is the box for the minutes and $2 the box for the days; keep both.

adv_catchUpHint.message: 通常の実行では、前回の実行以降の日付のメールだけを確認します。送信者は Date ヘッダーの日付をさかのぼって設定できるため、この広い範囲のスキャンで通常の実行が見逃したメールを拾います。どちらかの数値を大きくすると、1 回あたりの処理が増えます。
adv_catchUpHint.description: Explanation of the catch-up scan. Date is the name of a mail header; keep it.

adv_overlap.message: 通常のスキャンを $1 分重ねる
adv_overlap.description: Label around a number box. $1 is the number box; keep it.

adv_overlapHint.message: 各スキャンを前回の実行より何分前から始めるかを指定します。スキャン中に届いたメールや、日付が少し早いメールを見逃さないためのものです。

adv_showMenu.message: 右クリックメニューに Folder Filter Scheduler を表示する
adv_showMenu.description: Checkbox in the Advanced section. Folder Filter Scheduler is the name of the extension.

adv_showMenuHint.message: このメニューから、メッセージ一覧で迷惑メールのドメインを追加したり、ルールを実行したりできます。オフにしても、ツールバーボタンとこのページからルールを実行できます。変更を反映するには 保存 を選択します。
adv_showMenuHint.description: Explanation of the right-click menu checkbox. Keep … around the name of the Save button.

adv_shortName.message: ツールバーボタンと右クリックメニューで短い名前 FFS を使う
adv_shortName.description: Checkbox in the Advanced section. FFS is the short name of the extension; keep it.

adv_shortNameHint.message: 短い名前は場所を取りません。ツールバーボタンのツールチップには正式名称が表示されます。変更を反映するには 保存 を選択します。
adv_shortNameHint.description: Explanation of the short name checkbox. Keep … around the name of the Save button.

adv_authHeading.description: Subheading in the Advanced section for the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings.

adv_authOwn.message: DKIM を自分で検証する
adv_authOwn.description: Checkbox: the add-on checks DKIM signatures itself instead of trusting the mail provider. DKIM is a technical name; keep it.

adv_authOwnHint.message: 送信者は偽の Authentication-Results ヘッダーを追加できるため、アドオンが DKIM 署名を自分で検証し、その結果から DMARC を判定します。認証の条件が確認する各メッセージを全文ダウンロードし、署名の鍵を下の DNS サーバーに問い合わせます。DNS サーバーには、問い合わせたドメイン名が伝わります。オフにすると、メールプロバイダーが追加したヘッダーから DKIM と DMARC の結果を読み取ります。
adv_authOwnHint.description: Explanation of the own DKIM check. Keep Authentication-Results as is: it is the name of a mail header.

adv_authServer.description: Label in front of the list of DNS servers. $1 is the list; keep it.

adv_authServerHint.message: 初めて使うときに、Thunderbird がサーバーへのアクセスを許可するか確認します。
adv_authServerHint.description: Explanation under the DNS server list.

adv_authPrefer.message: 自分の検証とプロバイダーのヘッダーが一致しないときは $1 を使う
adv_authPrefer.description: Label around a list with two choices: adv_authPreferOwn and adv_authPreferProvider. $1 is the list; keep it.

adv_authPreferOwn.description: Choice in the list after "When my check and the provider's header disagree, use".

adv_authPreferProvider.message: プロバイダーのヘッダー
adv_authPreferProvider.description: Choice in the list after "When my check and the provider's header disagree, use".

adv_authPreferHint.message: プロバイダーのヘッダーを選んだ場合、アドオン自身の結果は、ヘッダーに含まれない検証にだけ使います。
adv_authPreferHint.description: Explanation of the choice between the own check and the provider's header.

adv_authTrusted.message: 信頼する認証サーバー $1
adv_authTrusted.description: Label in front of a text box. $1 is the text box; keep it.

adv_authTrustedPlaceholder.message:
1 行に 1 サーバー。例:
mta.yahoo.com
mx.google.com
adv_authTrustedPlaceholder.description: Gray example text in the empty box of trusted servers. Keep the line breaks (\n) and the server names.

adv_authTrustedHint.message: 空欄にすると、プロバイダーが最後に追加した一番上の Authentication-Results ヘッダーを信頼します。サーバー名を 1 行に 1 つずつ入力すると、そのいずれかによる一番上のヘッダーを使います。サーバー名はヘッダーの最初の単語で、mta.yahoo.com や mx.google.com のようなものです。
adv_authTrustedHint.description: Explanation of the trusted servers. Keep the text inside … as is.

help_otherFolderTitle.message: 送信済みトレイなど、受信トレイ以外のフォルダーでルールがメールを処理しない
help_otherFolderTitle.description: Help question. Use the names Thunderbird shows for the Sent and Inbox folders in your language.

help_otherFolderCause.message: IMAP アカウントでは、Thunderbird は初期設定で受信トレイだけの新着メールを確認します。アドオンが処理できるのは Thunderbird がダウンロードしたメッセージだけです。そのため、他のプログラムがあなたのアカウントから送信したメールや、サーバーのルールが振り分けたメールは、そのフォルダーを開くまで処理されません。すべてのルールを今すぐ実行 で処理できるように見えるのは、先にフォルダーを開いているためです。
help_otherFolderCause.description: Help answer, part 1. The text inside … is the name of a button (common_runAllRulesNow); use the same translation.

help_otherFolderFix.message: 解決するには、フォルダーを右クリックして プロパティ を開きます。一般情報 タブで このフォルダーに新着メッセージがないか確認する をオンにします。
help_otherFolderFix.description: Help answer, part 2. The text inside each … names a part of Thunderbird; copy the words Thunderbird uses in your language.

help_closedTitle.message: Thunderbird を閉じている間にメールが届いた

help_closedBody.message: ルールは Thunderbird の起動中にだけ実行されます。Thunderbird の起動後、最初のスケジュール実行で過去 30 日分 (または 詳細設定 で指定した日数分) を確認し、見逃したメールを処理します。
help_closedBody.description: Help answer. Advanced is the section heading adv_title; use the same word.

help_otherBody.message: 診断 を開き、レポートを GitHub issue に添付してください。レポートには、最近の各実行でスキャンした内容と一致した内容が表示されます。
help_otherBody.description: Help answer. Diagnostics is the section heading diag_title. The text inside … becomes the link to the issue tracker; keep the tags.

rule_collapseTitle.message: このルールを折りたたむ/展開する
rule_collapseTitle.description: Tooltip of the arrow button on a rule card.

rule_namePlaceholder.description: Gray text in the empty name box of a rule.

rule_newName.description: Name of a rule the user just added.

rule_enabled.description: Checkbox on a rule card: the rule runs when this is on.

rule_run.description: Button on a rule card that runs only this rule. Keep it short.

rule_runTitle.message: このルールだけを今すぐ、対象フォルダーのすべてのメッセージに実行します
rule_runTitle.description: Tooltip of the Run button on a rule card.

rule_delete.description: Button that deletes a rule card.

rule_folders.description: Label of the folder list of a rule. The label column is narrow; keep it short.

rule_foldersExpand.description: Small button under the Folders label that opens every account and folder in the list. One short word if you can.

rule_foldersExpandTitle.message: すべて展開: すべてのアカウントとサブフォルダーを表示
rule_foldersExpandTitle.description: Tooltip of the Expand button of the folder list.

rule_foldersCollapse.description: Small button under the Folders label that closes every account in the list. One short word if you can.

rule_foldersCollapseTitle.message: すべて折りたたむ: アカウント名だけを表示
rule_foldersCollapseTitle.description: Tooltip of the Collapse button of the folder list.

rule_folderFilter.message: フォルダーを絞り込む
rule_folderFilter.description: Gray text and screen reader label of the search box above the folder list.

rule_selectMatching.message: 一致するものをすべて選択
rule_selectMatching.description: Button that selects every folder the search box shows.

rule_includeSubfolders.message: サブフォルダー (今後作成するものも含む) を含める

rule_match.description: Label of the list that chooses between any and all conditions. The label column is narrow; keep it short.

rule_matchAny.message: いずれかの条件に一致 (OR)

rule_addCondition.description: Button that adds a condition row to a rule.

rule_addAction.description: Button that adds an action row to a rule.

rule_schedule.description: Label of the schedule part of a rule. The label column is narrow; keep it short.

rule_scheduleOn.message: このルールを独自のスケジュールで実行する
rule_scheduleOn.description: Checkbox that gives a rule its own cron schedule.

rule_cronLabel.description: Screen reader label of the box for the cron expression. Cron is a technical name.

rule_cronHelp.description: Link to crontab.guru, an English site that explains cron expressions.

rule_scheduleHint.message: cron 式は、分、時、日、月、曜日の 5 つのフィールドで構成され、コンピューターのローカル時刻で解釈されます。独自のスケジュールを設定したルールは、指定した時刻にだけ実行されます。ページ上部のタイマーや新着メールでは実行されなくなります。

schedule_error.description: Shown under the cron box when the expression is wrong. $1 is the reason (a cron_error message). Change only the final punctuation if your language needs it.

schedule_next.description: Shown under the cron box. $1 is the expression in words (for example "At 21:00 every day"); $2 is the date and time of the next run.

schedule_never.message: $1。この日付は存在しないため、ルールは実行されません。
schedule_never.description: Shown under the cron box for a date that does not exist, such as February 30. $1 is the expression in words.

cron_fieldMinute.description: Name of the 1st field of a cron expression, used in the cron_error messages.

cron_fieldHour.description: Name of the 2nd field of a cron expression, used in the cron_error messages.

cron_fieldDay.description: Name of the 3rd field of a cron expression, used in the cron_error messages.

cron_fieldMonth.description: Name of the 4th field of a cron expression, used in the cron_error messages.

cron_fieldWeekday.description: Name of the 5th field of a cron expression, used in the cron_error messages.

cron_errorEmpty.message: cron 式を入力してください
cron_errorEmpty.description: Error under the empty cron box. No final period: schedule_error adds it.

cron_errorTooLong.description: Error under the cron box. No final period.

cron_errorFieldCount.message: cron 式は分、時、日、月、曜日の 5 つのフィールドで構成されます。入力された式のフィールド数は $1 です
cron_errorFieldCount.description: Error under the cron box. $1 is the number of fields typed. No final period.

cron_errorInvalid.description: Error under the cron box. $1 is the text typed, $2 a field name (cron_field...). No final period. The first letter is made upper case.

cron_errorOutOfRange.message: $2～$3 の範囲で$1を指定してください (入力値: $4)
cron_errorOutOfRange.description: Error under the cron box. $1 is a field name (cron_field...), $2 and $3 the smallest and largest value, $4 the value typed. The first letter is made upper case. No final period.

cron_errorStep.message: $2の間隔「$1」は 1 以上にしてください
cron_errorStep.description: Error under the cron box, for a step such as */0. $1 is the step typed, $2 a field name (cron_field...). The first letter is made upper case. No final period.

cron_errorRange.description: Error under the cron box. $1 is the range typed, such as 1-2-3; $2 a field name (cron_field...). No final period.

cron_errorBackwards.message: $2の範囲「$1」が逆順になっています
cron_errorBackwards.description: Error under the cron box, for a range such as 5-1. $1 is the range typed, $2 a field name (cron_field...). The first letter is made upper case. No final period.

cron_range.description: Three or more values in a row in a schedule description, such as "Monday through Friday" or "1 through 5". $1 is the first value and $2 the last.

cron_atTimes.description: Start of a schedule description. $1 is a list of clock times, such as "08:30 and 20:30".

cron_everyMinutes_other.description: Start of a schedule description. $1 is the number of minutes.

cron_everyHourOnTheHour.description: A complete schedule description: at minute 0 of every hour.

cron_everyHourAtMinute.description: Start of a schedule description. $1 is a minute of the hour, such as 15.

cron_atMinutes_other.description: Start of a schedule description. $1 is a list of minutes, such as "0 and 30". The plural form follows the number of minutes in the list.

cron_timeAndHours.description: Joins the minutes part and the hours part of a schedule description: "Every 10 minutes, between 09:00 and 17:59". $1 is the minutes part, $2 the hours part.

cron_everyHours_other.description: Hours part of a schedule description. $1 is the number of hours.

cron_betweenHours.description: Hours part of a schedule description. $1 and $2 are clock times, such as 09:00 and 17:59.

cron_duringHours_other.description: Hours part of a schedule description. $1 is a list of hours, such as "9 and 12". The plural form follows the number of hours in the list.

cron_everyDay.description: Days part of a schedule description: "At 21:00 every day".

cron_onDaysOfMonth_other.description: Days part of a schedule description. $1 is a list of days, such as "1 and 15". The plural form follows the number of days in the list.

cron_onWeekdays.description: Days part of a schedule description. $1 is one or more weekday names, such as "Monday through Friday".

cron_inMonths.description: Months part of a schedule description. $1 is one or more month names, such as "January and July".

cron_withDays.description: Joins the time part and the days part of a schedule description: "At 09:00" + "on Monday". Swap $1 and $2 if your language puts the days first.

cron_withMonths.description: Adds the months part to a schedule description: "At 09:00" + "in January". Swap $1 and $2 if your language puts the months first.

folders_account.description: Heading in the folder list for an account that has no name.

folders_includedAsSubfolder.message: サブフォルダーとして対象
folders_includedAsSubfolder.description: Note after a folder name in the folder list: the rule scans this folder because its parent is selected.

folders_selectedInside_other.description: Note after a collapsed folder or account in the folder list. $1 is the number of selected folders it hides.

folders_expanded.description: Read by screen readers after the name of a folder whose subfolders are shown.

folders_collapsed.description: Read by screen readers after the name of a folder whose subfolders are hidden.

folders_countSelected_other.description: Count of selected folders, next to the folder search box. $1 is the number.

folders_countSubfolders_other.message: サブフォルダーとしてさらに $1 個
folders_countSubfolders_other.description: Added to the folder count: folders the rule also scans because a parent is selected. $1 is the number.

folders_countFiltered_other.message: $1 個は絞り込みで非表示
folders_countFiltered_other.description: Added to the folder count: selected folders the search box hides. $1 is the number.

folders_countFolded_other.message: $1 個は折りたたまれたフォルダー内
folders_countFolded_other.description: Added to the folder count: selected folders inside a collapsed folder or account. $1 is the number.

field_from.description: Condition field: the From header of a message. Lower case in English because it reads as part of a phrase: "from contains …".

field_reply_to.description: Condition field: the Reply-To header. You can keep the header name.

field_list_id.description: Condition field: the List-Id header of a mailing list. You can keep the header name.

field_age.description: Condition field: how many days old the message is.

field_read.description: Condition field: whether the message is read.

field_star.description: Condition field: whether the message has a star.

field_junk.description: Condition field: whether the message is marked as junk.

field_tag.description: Condition field: the Thunderbird tags of the message.

field_priority.description: Condition field: the priority of the message.

field_auth.description: Condition field: the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC checks of the sender.

op_contains.description: Condition operator, after a field: "subject contains …".

op_is.description: Condition operator, after a field: "from is …".

op_matchesRegex.message: が次の正規表現にマッチする
op_matchesRegex.description: Condition operator: the field matches a regular expression.

op_domainInList.message: のドメインが次のリストにある
op_domainInList.description: Condition operator: the domain of the address is in a list of domains.

op_inAddressBook.description: Condition operator: the address is in an address book.

op_nameShowsOtherAddress.message: の名前に別のアドレスが表示されている
op_nameShowsOtherAddress.description: Condition operator: the sender name contains an email address from another domain than the real address.

op_olderThan.description: Condition operator for the age field: "age older than 30 days".

op_newerThan.description: Condition operator for the age field.

op_isOn.description: Condition operator for the read, star, and junk fields. The page replaces it with a state message, such as "is read".

op_isOff.description: Condition operator for the read, star, and junk fields. The page replaces it with a state message, such as "is unread".

op_hasTag.description: Condition operator for the tag field.

op_priorityIs.description: Condition operator for the priority field: "priority is High".

op_authPasses.description: Condition operator for the authentication field: "authentication passes DKIM".

op_greyIsOn.message: 既読、スター付き、迷惑マークあり
op_greyIsOn.description: Grayed-out operator for a field it does not work with.

op_greyIsOff.message: 未読、スターなし、迷惑マークなし
op_greyIsOff.description: Grayed-out operator for a field it does not work with.

op_greyPriorityIs.description: Grayed-out operator for a field it does not work with.

op_ageOnly.description: Grayed-out operator. $1 is the operator, such as "older than".

op_ageOnlyReason.message: 経過日数の項目でのみ使用できます。

op_stateOnlyReason.message: 既読状態、スター、迷惑マークの項目でのみ使用できます。

op_tagOnly.description: Grayed-out operator. $1 is the operator, "has tag".

op_tagOnlyReason.message: タグの項目でのみ使用できます。

op_priorityOnlyReason.message: 重要度の項目でのみ使用できます。

op_authOnlyReason.message: 認証の項目でのみ使用できます。

op_headerOnly.description: Grayed-out operator. $1 is the operator, such as "contains".

op_headerOnlyReason.message: 差出人や件名などのヘッダー項目でのみ使用できます。

state_read_isOn.description: Operator text for the read field, and the summary of the condition.

state_read_isOff.description: Operator text for the read field, and the summary of the condition.

state_star_isOn.description: Operator text for the star field, and the summary of the condition.

state_star_isOff.description: Operator text for the star field, and the summary of the condition.

state_junk_isOn.description: Operator text for the junk field, and the summary of the condition.

state_junk_isOff.description: Operator text for the junk field, and the summary of the condition.
